text:
maria: planning to start the v2 rollout tonight 01:00 UTC. plan: header-gate + staged canary (1% -> 10% -> 50%) with automatic rollback on SLO breaches. flagging: hold EU until mobile SDK 1.2.4 ships. thoughts?

tom: +1 to header-gate. suggest auto-rollback if 5m error rate > 1.5% or p95 latency +30% versus baseline. can we make the region filter paramizable?

andrea: release notes draft needs a short migration snippet and a note about embedded schema change (minor). also we should call out clients that rely on implicit path-based versioning.

maria: agreed. release notes link: github.com/redwood/release-notes/pulls/432 (draft). migration snippet: `curl -X POST /v2/generate -H "x-api-version: 2" -d '{"prompt":"..."}'`

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: job=deploy-2024-06-12-v2-canary id=ddb-8842 start=2024-06-12T01:00Z canary=1% rollout=[1,10,50] auto_rollback=true rollback_triggers=["error_rate:1.5%_5m","p95_latency:+30%_5m"]

tom: please also add a client-pin window: mobile clients on older SDKs (<=1.2.3) should be excluded from v2 by default. we saw mobile SDKs ignore header in the wild.

andrea: on mobile note — mobile SDK 1.2.4 fixes header precedence for okhttp. it's in beta. i propose: start canary excluding eu-west-1 and traffic tagged as `mobile/<=1.2.3` until we get GA.

maria: decision: start global canary but exclude eu and legacy-mobile tag. ops: add exclusion filter to deploy bot. i'll update release notes to call out "EU hold" and SDK requirement.

deploy-bot: update applied to job ddb-8842: exclude_regions=["eu-west-1","eu-central-1"] exclude_client_tags=["mobile<=1.2.3"]. canary remains 1% for non-excluded traffic.

sre-oncall: quick heads-up — set alerting to forego noisy alerts for expected p95 blips during Canary. create a suppression for 2h after start.

tom: added suppression rule: alert-suppress/v2-canary-2h id=as-712. also added telemetry to capture `client_tag` and `x-api-version` in traces to validate fallback behavior.

andrea: release notes updated with migration snippet, known-issues (EU hold, mobile SDK), and rollback criteria. small sample text included: "Clients should send `x-api-version: 2` to opt-in; absence of the header will continue to default to v1 until SDK updates."

maria: can we add a short sanity check to gateway that logs when a request without header is routed to v2 (should not happen)? maybe `log.warn` with sample count.

tom: added `gateway.checks.header_routed_to_v2` metric and a hard deny if sample_count > 10 within 5m to prevent drift. config snippet: `if (!req.headers.x-api-version && routed_to_v2) { metric.inc(); if(metric.count(5m) > 10) { throw new Error("unexpected-v2-routing"); } }`

deploy-bot: canary started (non-eu) job=ddb-8842 canary=1% status=running eyes_on=true

maria: watching dashboards. tagging @sre-oncall for first 30m. :eyes:

sre-oncall: got it, live monitor up. ping if you want a manual rollback.

andrea: small ask — update release notes with exact SDK version strings for mobile CI so customers can grep. done.

tom: perf note: long-context prompts saw +8% CPU p95 during synthetic replay on canary; acceptable but keep an eye. enabling kv-cache profile `v2-kv-opt` on canary nodes should help.

maria: ok enable `v2-kv-opt` for canary only. ops, please confirm.

deploy-bot: config change applied: canary_nodes.profile=v2-kv-opt.

deploy-bot: EU hold remains in place; canary paused for eu regions.

maria: we'll reconvene 09:00 UTC tomorrow for a go/no-go on EU. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
